headline: Broad-based growth lifts profit across both segments
summary_short: Revenue rose to $4,907M (+14.7% y/y, +1.6% q/q) on base-business growth, net new business and an extra operating day in both segments, while diluted EPS climbed to $0.38 (+65.2% y/y) as margins widened and net interest expense fell.
summary_long: Revenue grew 14.7% y/y and 1.6% q/q to $4,907M on base-business growth and net new business in both segments (FSS US +12.2%, FSS International +20.8% q/q), aided by an estimated 3% operating-day benefit from fiscal 2025's 53rd week and ~2.4% favorable FX. Operating income rose 26.2% y/y to $220M as revenue growth outpaced higher food, personnel and commission costs; extra operating days added an estimated $25M. Net interest expense fell $7.5M on refinancing, and a lower 25.7% effective tax rate (vs 26.6% a year ago) helped lift net income 64.8% y/y to $102M and diluted EPS to $0.38. Cash stood at $476M; the company declared a $0.12/share dividend and repurchased $24.3M of stock. No formal quarterly guidance was given.

drivers.explanation: Broad-based revenue growth across both segments outpaced cost inflation, aided by an extra operating day from fiscal 2025's 53rd-week calendar shift and lower net interest expense from debt refinancing.
Base business growth and net new business in both segments, ~2.4% favorable FX translation, and an estimated 3% benefit from extra operating days tied to fiscal 2025's 53rd week.
Revenue growth outpaced higher food and beverage, personnel and commission costs; the extra operating days from the calendar shift added an estimated $25 million.
Driven by the operating income growth above plus $7.5 million lower net interest expense from refinancing, aided by a lower 25.7% effective tax rate versus 26.6% a year ago.
Tracks net income growth; diluted share count was essentially flat q/q and down only 0.4% y/y, so per-share growth closely matches net income growth.

Year-ago cash was elevated by roughly $1.4 billion of term-loan and note refinancing proceeds that did not recur; this year's financing activity relied on Receivables Facility and revolver borrowings instead.
Per the statement of stockholders' equity, net income and share-based compensation additions were only partly offset by $25.6 million of buybacks and $31.5 million of dividends declared this quarter.
